verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no rule- or event-trigger mechanism in Modal. HTTPS endpoints (modal-docs-14) and background spawning (modal-docs-15) are developer building blocks a user could wire to events. They are not product-level rules that fire actions automatically, and workspace budgets are an adjacent spend control, so none of these earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
